title: Lifecycle-safe frontend kernel
intent: Make Router, Store and Block lifecycle behavior deterministic without changing the public component architecture.

requirements.title: Router, Store and Block lifecycle
requirements.description: Add parameterized/lazy routes, typed slice updates, shallow comparison and deterministic destroy/unsubscribe behavior, with a debt handoff for the architecture guard.

constraints: Consume stage 1 configuration; do not rewrite it.
Do not edit guard debt map; emit handoff only.
